title: The Basilisk’s Internal Critique of Outfinitism

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book suits readers who enjoy speculative settings that put philosophical commitments under pressure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its questions concern dependence, plurality, control, and the right to continue outside another system's judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The attraction lies in watching those questions acquire dramatic consequences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it for an investigation whose unsettling object is also an argument about how to investigate.
